title: Safe cross-session operator workflow

sourceMap.title: Choose a safe cross-session operator workflow

decisionSources.title: Choose the decision source of truth

problemStatement: Multi-session work loses correctness when decisions live only in model context or duplicated summaries.
solution: Use a tracker-backed Wayfinder map whose typed child tickets own decision detail, then synthesize a temporary implementation specification after the route is clear.
userStories: As an operator, I want the current frontier visible in the tracker so that I can start an eligible decision without reconstructing prior sessions.
As an operator, I want HITL decisions to require my real response so that an agent cannot infer approval.
As an implementer, I want the final specification linked to the decisions that shaped it so that I can zoom into rationale without keeping the spec forever.
implementationDecisions: Tracker child tickets are the primary detailed decision authority.
The public plan is a repository coordination mirror rather than a shadow decision tracker.
Research, prototype, grilling, and task labels route to distinct workflow gates.
Implementation tickets are created only after the decision route is clear.
testingDecisions: Validate ticket type/label/interaction combinations with a closed Draft 2020-12 schema.
Validate HITL and research evidence floors in deterministic contract classes.
Validate GitHub command construction separately from live tracker permission/runtime proof.
outOfScope: Production deployment and user acceptance of the destination implementation.
furtherNotes: The spec is a temporary compression layer; closed decision tickets remain durable history.
